result.rationale: The migration inserts hosts verbatim (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) from the old embeddable_hosts setting, while `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` matches `lower(host) = uri.host` exactly. The before_validation scheme/path stripping only runs on AR save, not on raw SQL inserts. Since the old `allows_embeddable_host?` normalized entries via `URI(h).host`, previously-accepted entries like 'http://example.com' would stop matching post-migration, silently breaking embeds for those sites.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies old SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts lines directly into the embeddable_hosts table via raw SQL ("VALUES ('#{h}', ...)") and bypasses the EmbeddableHost model’s before_validation normalization that strips scheme and paths. The new allow-check path (EmbedController#ensure_embeddable and TopicRetriever#invalid_host?) calls EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? -> record_for_host, which parses the referer/embed URL and then queries `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`. If the migrated DB rows contain `http://example.com` or `https://example.com/123`, they will not equal `uri.host` (e.g., `example.com`), causing previously-valid hosts to become invalid after upgrade, matching the finding’s described failure mode.
